locus.output_selection: tensor output of Dinov2 block 11 of 12, (B, 1370, 768); the backbone's LayerNorm is applied to it and the result is feature_maps['stage12'], which the projector consumes

locus.affected_branch: the single image-token stream the backbone emits as its one output stage
locus.bypasses: none: the backbone's final LayerNorm is ON the consumed path (apply_layernorm=True), so a write here reaches the projector through it
locus.notes: tower DINOv2 ViT-B/14 at 518 px, fine-tuned on chest radiographs by the MAIRA-2 authors
